name: Jakelian
description: The Jakelians were a sentient species from the Outer Rim Territories' Jakelia system. They developed edged weapons and, during the Mandalorian Crusades, became a vassal species of the Taung Mandalorian Crusaders. Later, during the reign of Mandalore the Ultimate, Jakelians were among the species whose members became full members of the Mandalorian clans.
